long_biography.plain_text:
Zelada has maintained an active Florida corporate presence since FJZ Management was incorporated in 2011. He remains its president, with the company active in office administrative and management services. At Longview Ventures, he has served as registered agent while the company maintained its active Florida registration.

His nonprofit work includes vice-presidential service at 305 Gives Back and The Imaginate Foundation. Their grant-making has supported youth development, musical education, disaster relief and wider charitable purposes. The roles are unpaid. Together, these activities establish continuing company administration and foundation governance, with responsibilities divided between private enterprise and community-focused organisations in South Florida.
